observations: Three photos show technical drawings of a plastic bottle, likely for a 750ml container, with dimensions and mold design details.
The drawings include side views, top views, and cross-sections of the bottle, with measurements in millimeters.
The text on the drawings is in Chinese, including '750ml' and '瓶胚' (bottle preform).
The drawings are placed on wooden crates, suggesting they are part of a shipment or mold set.
No actual machine, mold, or equipment is visible — only blueprints.
The seller mentions 'Pure water machine dingli', 'Monoblock', 'Semi auto shrink' in their text, but none of these are shown in the photos.
